#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

CERT_ROOT=/etc/nginx/tls
CURRENT_LINK="$CERT_ROOT/current"
RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS="${RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS:-2592000}"
CERT_VALID_DAYS="${CERT_VALID_DAYS:-90}"
FORCE_ROTATE="${FORCE_ROTATE:-0}"
LOCK_FILE=/run/rotate-https-certificate.lock

exec 9>"$LOCK_FILE"
flock -n 9 || { echo "certificate rotation already running"; exit 0; }

if [[ "$FORCE_ROTATE" != "1" && -r "$CURRENT_LINK/cert.pem" ]] && \
   openssl x509 -checkend "$RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS" -noout -in "$CURRENT_LINK/cert.pem" >/dev/null; then
    echo "certificate remains valid beyond renewal window"
    exit 0
fi

host_name="$(hostname -s)"
node_ip="$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')"
[[ -n "$node_ip" ]] || { echo "unable to determine node IPv4 address" >&2; exit 1; }
stamp="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$"
new_name="cert-$stamp"
new_dir="$CERT_ROOT/$new_name"
tmp_link="$CERT_ROOT/.current-$stamp"
old_target="$(readlink "$CURRENT_LINK" 2>/dev/null || true)"

cleanup() {
    rm -f "$tmp_link"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

install -d -m 0700 "$new_dir"
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -nodes \
    -days "$CERT_VALID_DAYS" \
    -subj "/CN=$host_name" \
    -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:$host_name,IP:$node_ip" \
    -keyout "$new_dir/key.pem" \
    -out "$new_dir/cert.pem" >/dev/null 2>&1
chmod 0600 "$new_dir/key.pem"
chmod 0644 "$new_dir/cert.pem"

cert_key_id="$(openssl x509 -in "$new_dir/cert.pem" -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
private_key_id="$(openssl pkey -in "$new_dir/key.pem" -pubout -outform DER 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
[[ "$cert_key_id" == "$private_key_id" ]] || { echo "generated certificate and key do not match" >&2; exit 1; }
openssl x509 -in "$new_dir/cert.pem" -noout -checkend 3600 >/dev/null

ln -s "$new_name" "$tmp_link"
mv -Tf "$tmp_link" "$CURRENT_LINK"

if ! nginx -t; then
    if [[ -n "$old_target" ]]; then
        ln -s "$old_target" "$tmp_link"
        mv -Tf "$tmp_link" "$CURRENT_LINK"
    else
        rm -f "$CURRENT_LINK"
    fi
    echo "nginx rejected the new certificate; previous certificate restored" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if systemctl is-active --quiet nginx; then
    if ! systemctl reload nginx; then
        if [[ -n "$old_target" ]]; then
            ln -s "$old_target" "$tmp_link"
            mv -Tf "$tmp_link" "$CURRENT_LINK"
            nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx
        fi
        echo "nginx reload failed; previous certificate restored" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

serial="$(openssl x509 -in "$CURRENT_LINK/cert.pem" -noout -serial | cut -d= -f2)"
not_after="$(openssl x509 -in "$CURRENT_LINK/cert.pem" -noout -enddate | cut -d= -f2-)"
echo "installed certificate serial=$serial not_after=$not_after"
ANTRIEB_ROTATE_SCRIPT
